locations.note: The journey starts and ends in London, from 2 October 1899.
In Cairo Oliver fights tomb robbers in the catacombs, enters the harem and finds the first trinket.
In Bombay Oliver finds the snake temple and rescues Ravish.
In Yokohama Oliver reaches the Shogun's palace and the Emperor.
San Francisco holds the fourth trinket, at the City Archives and Fix's office.

routes.name: Oliver
routes.note: Around the world from London and back.
